verdict.rationale: Asking for llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is fair for a government registry web service, so the axis applies. The only evidence is that agents get HTTP 403 at robots.txt on both mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched. There is no evidence of an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation, and the wall suggests agents are being kept out.
